Set within the most dynamic and well-served area of town, just steps away from Piazza Mazzini, this single house represents a rare opportunity for annual rent for those seeking generous spaces, absolute independence, and a privileged location. The property stands out for its bright and well-distributed rooms. The living area opens up to a welcoming atmosphere designed to fully enjoy daily life or entertain guests in total relaxation. The sleeping area includes three spacious bedrooms. Completing the internal layout are two full bathrooms. The true added value lies in the complete autonomy of the home: zero condominium fees, no neighbors above or next door, and priceless tranquility. Immediate proximity to the sea and Piazza Mazzini allows you to experience city life without needing a car, with renowned restaurants, boutiques, and all kinds of essential services at your fingertips.
